body:
## Problem

Two independent, unrelated fabrications for Jason Bittner, both confirmed still live:

**1. Join-year error — `packages/frontend/data/top10Lists.js` line ~2834:**
> "Jason Bittner joined Shadows Fall in **2001** and powered the band's commercial breakthrough..."

Ground truth: `packages/frontend/data/drummerEvolution.js` (`totalYearsActive: '1999-Present'`, era `jason-bittner-1999-early-shadows-fall`, years `'1999–2004'`) and `packages/frontend/data/extendedBios.js` FAQ ("previously drummed for Shadows Fall (**1999**-2015)") both independently confirm **1999**, not 2001. This single entry in `top10Lists.js` (introduced in commit `398ea0e8` / #3804, never touched since) is the only place on the site with the wrong year.

**2. Snare model error — `packages/frontend/data/soundLikeGuides.js`, lines ~15075 and ~15084 (setup/config) and ~15208 (FAQ):**
> `snare: '14" x 6.5" Mapex Saturn V Steel'` / "a 14\" x 6.5\" Mapex Saturn V Steel snare"

Ground truth, confirmed correct in `extendedBios.js` FAQ: "Jason Bittner's snare is a **Mapex Black Panther 14"x6.5" Brass**" (this exact model was the subject of closed fixes #5542/#5555/#5556 correcting the brand elsewhere). A separate fix (commit `e6f70c1c` / #6579/#6612) already corrected this same `soundLikeGuides.js` file's kit *brand* from Tama→Mapex, but left this fabricated "Saturn V Steel" snare model untouched.

## Fix

1. In `top10Lists.js` line ~2834, change "joined Shadows Fall in 2001" → "joined Shadows Fall in 1999."
2. In `soundLikeGuides.js`, replace all 3 "Mapex Saturn V Steel 14"x6.5"" snare references (lines ~15075 setup.config.snare, ~15084-15090 dedicated snare block incl. its `description`/`alternative` sub-fields describing the steel shell's tonal character, and ~15208 FAQ answer) with "Mapex Black Panther 14"x6.5" Brass," rewriting the surrounding tonal-character prose to describe a brass shell (not steel) where the sentence depends on shell material.

## Verify

1. `grep -n "2001" packages/frontend/data/top10Lists.js` no longer shows a Jason Bittner/Shadows Fall join-year claim.
2. `grep -n "Saturn V Steel" packages/frontend/data/soundLikeGuides.js` returns zero matches.
3. The rewritten snare prose in `soundLikeGuides.js` no longer describes a steel shell's tonal character for Bittner's snare.
4. Cross-check `extendedBios.js` FAQ and `drummerEvolution.js` — all files now agree on 1999 join year and Black Panther Brass snare.

## Done

Jason Bittner's Shadows Fall join year (1999) and snare model (Mapex Black Panther 14"x6.5" Brass) are consistent across `top10Lists.js`, `soundLikeGuides.js`, `extendedBios.js`, and `drummerEvolution.js`.
title: SEO: Jason Bittner — top10Lists.js wrong Shadows Fall join year (2001 vs verified 1999) + soundLikeGuides.js wrong snare model (Saturn V Steel vs verified Black Panther Brass)
